summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling blob unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: This package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array with a `WV8StW` rotator and thousands of encoded tokens) that is not part of the declared `files` manifest (which lists only `lib`) and is unrelated to the advertised Apollo link timeout functionality. The `lib/` sources match the benign upstream `apollo-link-timeout` library, while the preinstall and obfuscated blob are additions on top; the package is published under the `@ornikar` scope but its declared author and repository point at the unscoped upstream author `drcallaway`, consistent with a scope-squat / trojanized-fork shape. Installing this package on default `npm install` fetches an alternate runtime and executes an opaque obfuscated payload on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
